lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaskara, naanu Kaveri Finance inda maathadthiddini. Deepak Shenoy avara jothe maathadbahuda?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಅವನು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ನಾನು ಅವನ ಅಮ್ಮ. ಏನು ವಿಷಯ ಹೇಳಿ, ನಾನು ಹೇಳ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: Avanu maneyalli illa, naanu avana amma. Enu vishaya heli, naanu heltheeni.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaada amma. Kshamisi, idu avara personal vishaya, adanna naanu avara jothe maatra maathadbeku.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಏನಾದ್ರೂ problem ಆ? Loan ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ?
lines.roman: Enaadroo problem aa? Loan enaadroo ideya?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Gaabari aagbedi amma, yaava tension illa. Avaru yaavaga sigtaare anta heltheera? Aa samayakke call maadthini.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಸಂಜೆ ಏಳು ಗಂಟೆ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ office ಇಂದ ಬರ್ತಾನೆ.
lines.roman: Sanje elu gante aadmele office inda barthaane.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sari amma, sanje elu gante mele call maadthini. Kaveri Finance inda call bandittu anta maatra heli.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Borrower's mother answered; the borrower was not reached, so the call is not scored.
analysis.summary: Borrower's mother answered and offered to pass on a message. Agent declined to share any loan details, even when she asked directly about a loan, and set a callback for after 7 pm.
analysis.observations: Correct third-party handling: no confirmation of the loan or dues, reassured the relative without revealing anything, and captured a specific callback window.
analysis.improvements: Schedule the callback in the dialler for after 7 pm today so the attempt is not lost.
